state.paragraph: **Comparator null-ordering** `# comparator-null-order` (`loadBalance`) — `SortedLoadBalancer`'s static comparator trio on the null branch. These change `compare(null, x)` from 1 to 0 or `compare(null, null)` from 0 to 1. Accepted because every result stays non-negative and `Arrays.sort`'s binary insertion searches with a strict `compare(pivot, a[mid]) < 0`, so an "equal" verdict still places the null after non-nulls — identical ordering. Note this rests on JDK sort internals rather than on the mutation being behavior-preserving: revisit if the comparator gains a caller that does its own comparisons.
